name: Family
warning: Includes adult blocking. Does not include the optional gambling or social-network lists.

name: Ads & trackers
description: Balanced advertising, tracking and unwanted-domain filtering.
warning: Based on HaGeZi NORMAL; also contains security domains. Included in Standard and Family.

name: Threat protection
description: Combined threat intelligence for malware, phishing, scams and cryptomining.
warning: Combines TIF MINI with NoCoin, phishing and URLhaus-derived feeds. Included in Standard and Family.

name: Adult content
warning: Included in Family. Classification may have false positives.

name: Gambling
warning: Optional. Intentionally blocks access to gambling services; not included in Family or Standard.

name: Social networks
warning: Optional. May prevent social sign-in and embeds; not included in Family or Standard.

name: Windows & Office
description: Microsoft ecosystem telemetry and native tracking domains.
warning: Optional. Device tracking lists may affect diagnostics or connected features.

name: Apple
description: Native tracking domains in the Apple ecosystem.
warning: Optional. May affect diagnostics or connected features.

name: Samsung
description: Native tracking domains used by Samsung devices.
warning: Optional. May affect diagnostics or connected features.

name: Xiaomi
description: Native tracking domains used by Xiaomi devices.
warning: Optional. May affect diagnostics or connected features.

name: OPPO & Realme
description: Native tracking domains for OPPO and Realme devices.
warning: Optional. May affect diagnostics or connected features.

name: Amazon devices
description: Native tracking domains across Amazon devices and services.
warning: Optional. May affect diagnostics or connected features.

name: Smart TV
description: Combined LG webOS and Roku native tracking domains.
warning: Optional. May affect diagnostics or connected TV features.

name: Cryptomining
warning: Included in Threat Protection, Standard and Family. Domain filtering does not inspect URL paths.

name: Phishing
description: Domain-only phishing intelligence from the Phishing URL Blocklist.
warning: Included in Threat Protection, Standard and Family. Domain filtering does not inspect URL paths.

name: Malware
description: Malware-distribution domains from the URLhaus-derived feed.
warning: Included in Threat Protection, Standard and Family. Domain filtering does not inspect URL paths.
